## Exclusion checks

**Does the project create, require, reward, trade, or otherwise depend on a cryptocurrency, token, NFT, DAO, DeFi system, or financial incentive layer?**

<!--
If yes, the project is out of scope.

Using an existing blockchain solely as a neutral public record may qualify when:

- the project has no token of its own;
- users do not need to buy or speculate on a token;
- no financial incentive layer is required; and
- the project provides useful decentralized-web infrastructure.

If claiming this exception, explain it below.
-->

**Does the project use a blockchain in any other way? If yes, explain:**

## Checklist

- [ ] I am submitting only one project.
- [ ] The project is open source and has a working implementation.
- [ ] Decentralization is fundamental to its architecture.
- [ ] I provided evidence of recent activity or mature stability.
- [ ] I provided evidence of real adoption.
- [ ] The project complies with the cryptocurrency, token, and AI exclusions.
